'''Simple Chest''' is a blueprint used to store items. It can be crafted at most locations with a Blueprint Desk. It has 20 storage slots, with each slot holding one stack of an item.

== Obtaining ==

* Can be build in:
** {{Blueprint|Yard|text=no}} [[Yard]]
** {{Blueprint|Home|text=no}} [[Home]]
** {{Blueprint|Alchemy Lab|text=no}} [[Alchemy Lab]]
** {{Blueprint|Writing Room|text=no}} [[Writing Room]]
